cards.text: Stephen, one of the seven men chosen to help with the church's daily food distribution (Acts 6:1-5), is standing in front of the Sanhedrin, the Jewish ruling council (Acts 6:12). False witnesses say he never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law, and I bet you could hear a crumb drop in that room (Acts 6:13). Then the high priest turns to Stephen.

cards.question: Stephen stands before the council with false witnesses speaking against him. What does the high priest ask him?

answers.text: Who gave him the right to teach

cards.text: Stephen doesn't give a yes or a no. He goes ALL the way back to the God of glory appearing to Abraham in Mesopotamia, like when you ask somebody how their day was and they start with the year they were born.

cards.question: God tells Abraham, “Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.” What does Abraham do?

answers.text: He leaves and settles in Haran
He waits for God to send a sign
He sends a servant to look first

cards.text: After his father dies, God brings Abraham into the land the council lives in now, but gives him not even a foot of ground. God promises the land to Abraham's descendants before he even has a child, and says they'll be foreigners in a strange land, enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

cards.question: God says He will ___ the nation that enslaves Abraham's descendants.
God says that afterward, Abraham's descendants will come out and worship Him in the land He brought Abraham to.

cards.text: God gives Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and the family line runs through Isaac and Jacob to the twelve patriarchs. The patriarchs are jealous of their brother Joseph, so they sell him as a slave into Egypt.

cards.question: But God is with Joseph. He rescues Joseph from all his troubles and gives him favor and wisdom in front of Pharaoh king of Egypt. What does Pharaoh make Joseph?

answers.text: Ruler over Egypt and Pharaoh's household

cards.question: Famine hits Egypt and Canaan, and Jacob sends his sons to Egypt for grain, where their brother Joseph now rules. On their second visit, what does Joseph do?

answers.text: He reveals who he is to them
He sends them home with nothing
He has them thrown in prison

cards.text: Joseph sends for his father Jacob and all his relatives, SEVENTY-FIVE in all. Jacob goes down to Egypt, where he and his sons die, and their bones are carried back to the tomb Abraham bought at Shechem.

Israel's people grow greatly in number, until a new king who knew nothing of Joseph forces them to abandon their infants so they would die. At that time Moses is born, and Pharaoh's daughter takes him and brings him up as her own son.

cards.question: At forty, Moses, educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, strikes down an Egyptian who is mistreating an Israelite. He assumes his brothers will understand that God is using him to ___ them.

cards.text: His brothers don't understand. The next day Moses tries to make peace between two fighting Israelites, like stepping between two coworkers mid-argument, and the one in the wrong shoves HIM aside: “Who made you ruler and judge over us?”
Moses flees to the land of Midian. Forty years later, an angel appears to him in the flames of a burning bush near Mount Sinai, and the voice of the Lord comes to him.

cards.question: The Lord says He has seen His people's oppression, heard their groaning and come down to deliver them. He tells Moses He will send him back to ___.
The man who pushed Moses aside asked, “Who made you ruler and judge?” Stephen says God sent that same Moses to be their ruler and ___.

cards.text: Moses leads them out with wonders and signs, and he's the one who said God would raise up a prophet like him. But the fathers refuse to obey him, make a calf idol, and God gives them over to the worship of the host of heaven.

cards.question: Stephen quotes the book of the prophets: the people carried along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of Rephan, idols they made to worship. What does God say He will do?

answers.text: Send them into exile beyond Babylon
Lead them back to Mount Sinai
Hand them back over to Pharaoh

cards.text: Pause right there, friend. Stephen's still got the floor, and he is NOT finished.
